selection_reason: On the common 47 TimesX origins, keyword+direction (Sdir) and four-index model (M) had modestly lower aggregate MAE than B1; neither was validated. Long-decade and monthly results showed instability and are not pooled with this dataset.
primary: Cavg = 0.5*Sdir + 0.5*M; compare paired MAE with B1 and both components

secondary_candidates.Cjoint: B1 + all four index features + keyword rates/event count + eight direction features in one ridge model
secondary_candidates.Cslim: B1 + all four index features + eight direction features, excluding keyword rates/count

fixed_choices: Same 47 origins, 66 original samples, target, train cutoff, ridge lambda=1 and train-only scaling. Index bar lag 48h remains unchanged. No weight optimization, topic selection, index subset search or threshold tuning.
excluded_features: Actor/surprise, generic word hashing and stale text are not in new candidates. Their prior negative results remain published; this selection is explicitly based on already-seen outcomes.
report: All candidates, overall and 2024/2025/2026 blocks, numeric baseline and components, naive baseline, descriptive paired time-block intervals, counts, and component prediction correlation. 2026 has four origins and is not a new holdout.
stop_rule: No additional combinations after viewing these results. An aggregate winner is only a candidate for a new future-data test, not validated for use.
limitations: Repeated model selection on the same outcomes
Historical news publication and numerical vintages unresolved
Not a reproduction of the 10-year or 13-month experiment
No calibrated warning probabilities or investment recommendation
No market-flow data or full-context language model
